captured_cases.expected_outcome: Reject a path that never existed.

atomic_step.outcome: The registered publisher accepts exact manifest paths already staged as deletions while still rejecting nonexistent paths.
atomic_step.practical_value: Approved retirements can be committed and pushed through the normal publisher without weakening manifest scope.
atomic_step.stopping_condition: A staged tracked deletion publishes through the boundary and a never-tracked missing path remains rejected.

composition.assembly_contract: Use the selected deletion identity boundary unchanged.

final_validation.operator_path: invoke manifest_paths on disposable Git repositories matching the captured cases
final_validation.success_criterion: Both path classifications match their declared outcomes.

approaches.hypothesis: HEAD tree membership proves a staged deletion was previously tracked.
approaches.implementation: Accept a missing index path when its exact blob exists in HEAD.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Simple, but recognizes history rather than the current deletion state.

approaches.hypothesis: The HEAD diff can prove the exact path is currently deleted.
approaches.implementation: Accept only an exact path reported by Git with deletion status.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: One bounded Git diff per missing manifest entry, with semantics local to this boundary.

mini_probes.goal: Recognize a missing manifest path as an exact tracked deletion without admitting an invented path.
mini_probes.practical_value: Approved retirements can be committed and pushed through the normal publisher without weakening manifest scope.

proof.success_criterion: The staged deletion is accepted and the invented path is rejected.

mini_probes.work_type_reason: Git path identity and deletion status are deterministic repository facts.
